title: DTC 41 IG Power Source Circuit
ocr_text:
BR–92
BRAKE SYSTEM – ANTI–LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS)

DTC 41 IG Power Source Circuit

CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

This is the power source for the ECU, hence the CPU and the actuators.

DTC No. | Diagnostic Trouble Code Detecting Condition' | Trouble area

41
When either of the following (1) or (2) is detected:
(1) Voltage at ECU terminal IG1 is less than 9.5 V for more than 10 sec. while vehicle speed is 3 km/h (1.9 mph) or more.
(2) Voltage at ECU terminal IG1 is more than 17 V for more than 1.2 sec.
Battery
IC regulator
Open or short in power source circuit
ECU

Fail safe function: If trouble occurs in the power source circuit, the ECU cuts off current to the ABS solenoid relay and prohibits ABS control.
